steps.title: Finish setup in the upstream Android app
steps.instruction: This fork’s published APK is for Android, specifically the AYN Thor dual-screen UZDoom route. Install this fork’s APK on the Android device, open its launcher deliberately, and select your own compatible Doom-family IWAD/content through the UZDoom setup. Other engines named in the inherited parent README have been excluded from this fork; do not prepare Doom RPG, Wolfenstein RPG or another parent engine for this APK.

steps.title: Keep your data when changing versions
steps.instruction: Keep your selected IWADs, mods and actual Android app data backed up before changing versions. This fork’s reviewed guide does not establish an exact save/export location. Its UZDoom renderer notes distinguish Adreno from Mali/PowerVR; follow the fork’s device guidance. Updates and device setup belong to the upstream Android app, outside Portcove runtime backup and rollback.
